cs.t: MacBook Air, iPhone, one pair of Birkenstocks, one North Face down jacket, three identical linen outfits, Phillips electric razor, suitcase, umbrella, bicycle, and basic toiletries. I don’t own anything else. My current apartment is furnished with beds and kitchen. I’ll be moving soon and will probably need to purchase a futon and kitchenware. My only subscriptions are iCloud, Fastmail, Linode, and a virtual mailbox. I also have some subscription services for different businesses. Subscriptions total around $100. I use iTerm, nushell, helix editor, and the rest stock Apple apps (Notes, Calendar, Reminders, Numbers, Freeform, etc.). I love living this way, and to each their own :)
